note: The website's films live on the site-media GitHub Release, never in git, so the repo and every checkout install stay lean. scripts/fetch-site-media.mjs pulls them into site/media/ (pages.yml runs it on every deploy; run it locally before a preview). scripts/encode-film.mjs records new files here and scripts/publish-site-media.mjs uploads them. Release assets are named by each file's basename. Contract: docs/design/site-cinema.md
